profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company, according to its own site, founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley. It describes its core technology as a "virtual driver" and organizes its work into three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). The company says it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations worldwide, and that its vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024.

The company states that it is pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility everywhere and describes itself as a global leader in autonomous mobility and a pioneer in extending autonomous mobility technologies and services. It reports accumulating millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios, including difficult weather and road conditions, and says this work is the foundation for delivering autonomous driving systems at scale.

Pony AI Inc. is a for-profit public company with headquarters in Guangzhou, China, and trades under the ticker PONY. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001969302.
